from app.concurrency import map_with_concurrency


# CASE py_fourth_arg_local_one expect=pass
async def x1(items, save, width):
    retries = 1
    await map_with_concurrency(items, save, width, retries)


# CASE py_fourth_arg_literal_one expect=pass
async def x2(items, save, width):
    await map_with_concurrency(items, save, width, 1)


# CASE py_end expect=pass
